question: Yahan naye tainaat hone wale afsar ke liye ek mukhtasar orientation note likhein — unhein mojooda case load se kya tawaqqo rakhni chahiye?
expected_answer: Aap 9 zilon mein phaili 73 khuli FIRs sambhaal rahe hain, zyada bojh Faisalabad aur Lahore mein. Case load haal hi mein badla hai: do saal pehle taqreeban sab kuch armed robbery tha; ab manshiyat, cyber fraud aur online haraasgi, mali fraud, aghwa aur qatal ka mishra hai, jisme armed robbery ab bhi sab se bara silsila hai. Zyada tar mulzim aisay mard hain jo apni pachees se chalees baras ki umar mein hain, aam tor par mudai ke liye ajnabi. Tawaqqo rakhein ke cases sust raftari se chalenge — girftari sirf har chhe mein se taqreeban ek FIR par darj hai aur zyada tar maamlaat abhi adaalaton mein zeir-e-samaat hain. Fraud aur cyber cases ab waqe ke kaafi baad report hote hain, purani dakaityon ke bar-aks jo minton mein aa jati thein. Hathiyar ki baramadgi aam hai aur taqreeban hamesha bila-license.
actual_answer:
For a new officer joining this caseload, the following orientation note outlines key considerations:  

**District Concentration**: Cases are concentrated in **فیصل آباد** (Faisalabad: 19 cases), **لاہور** (Lahore: 18 cases), and **راولپنڈی** (Rawalpindi: 10 cases), with smaller numbers in other districts [Document 1].  

**Case Mix**: The caseload now includes a broad range of offenses under multiple statutes (e.g., **PPC**, **CNSA 1997**, **PECA 2016**) compared to 2024, when cases were limited to **PPC** and **Arms Ordinance 1965** [Document 2].  

**Arrests**: Only **11 of 73 FIRs** record an arrest (1 in 6.6), with **62 FIRs** having no arrests [Document 3].  

**Reporting Delays**: The mean time from incident to report is **~23.4 hours** (1401.3 minutes) in 2026, significantly slower than **15 minutes** in 2024 [Document 4].  

**Weapon Licensing**: **32 cases** involve recovered weapons with **no licence recorded or unverifiable licence status** [Document 5].  

**Accused Profile**: **92 accused individuals** are recorded, with ages spanning **24–49 years** (average: 31.5) for **17 of 92** (age data is incomplete) [Document 6]. Relationships between accused and complainant are recorded in **10 FIRs**, with **"اجنبی" (stranger)** being the most common (15 of 24 entries) [Document 7].  

**Court Progress**: **32 of 33 cases** remain in progress, and only **1 case** has reached a verdict [Document 8].  

This caseload requires attention to diverse legal statutes, delayed reporting, limited arrests, and ongoing court proceedings. Officers should prioritize thorough documentation and coordination with licensing authorities for weapon-related cases.

question: Jab koi shakhs mashkook halaat mein foat ho jaye, to police ko maut ki wajah ki baaqaida tehqeeqaat karni hoti hai — kya hamara system yeh kahin darj karta hai, khaas tor par jab hamare itne cases mein maut shamil hai?

Hamara data zahir karta hai ke aise cases mojood hain: 10 FIRs qatl ki dafa (PPC 302) ka hawala dete hain, aur kai zabt shuda property entries meyyat ke warisaan ko wapas karne ke liye nishaanzad hain. Magar schema mein kahin koi inquest, post-mortem ya cause-of-death record nahi. FIR aur uski dafaat yeh darj karti hain ke maut ka daawa kiya gaya hai; woh alag qanooni maut ki tehqeeqaat ko darj nahi kartin.
